evidence_semantic_checks: unique IDs; source/observation lineage; revision chronology; acyclic links; reconstructed publication/availability; missing advance GDI; calculation arithmetic; raw-file hashes

markdown_checks.scope: top-level Markdown files; table column counts, local file links and unexpected control characters

frozen_v1.example_schema_result: known failure; corrected master replacement provided

errors.message: must be equal to one of the allowed values

limits: Checks establish structure and stated internal invariants; official-source fact review is separate and no predictive performance is established.
